title: Personal Assistant to a High Performing Business Owners
description:
You’ve been doing this work well for a long time.

You anticipate. You solve. You protect the calendar before the conflict happens. You’ve made your executive’s world run smoothly — often without them realizing how much you were carrying.

But somewhere along the way, the environment stopped matching your standards. Too much oversight. Not enough trust. A business you do the work for but don’t really believe in.





This is the role for what comes next.



THE ROLE

We are Market Leaders — a coaching and marketing education brand that supports high-performing business owners across Financial Advisory, Real Estate, Coaching, and Education. As part of our client services team, we’re placing a dedicated PA to support one of our clients directly.

You’ll own the calendar, the inbox, client onboarding, admin operations, social media, GHL — and make everything run before anyone has to ask.



WHAT YOU BRING

• 2+ years of executive assistant or PA experience

• Expert cross-timezone calendar management (Google Calendar)

• Professional written and verbal English

• CRM and client management experience

• Proficiency in GHL, social media, and admin tools

• Philippines-based, available SGT hours (GMT+8)

• Proactive problem-solver who anticipates needs

• High attention to detail, zero tolerance for errors

• Reliable home office setup, stable internet (Philippines-based)

• Singapore Time Zone availability (GMT+8), flexible hours





WHAT YOU GET

• Full trust and autonomy from day one — no micromanagement

• A mission you can genuinely believe in

• Remote 



What You'll Do



Manage executive calendar with zero conflicts

Handle all
 correspondence professionally, responding within 2 hours

Coordinate customer onboarding from inquiry to activation

Solve problems proactively - anticipate challenges and eliminate chaos

Bridge operations across creative teams, clients, and leadership





A NOTE ON CULTURE

We have a strict no brilliant jerks policy. Skills matter deeply here — so does how you show up for the people around you.

You’re our kind of person if you deliver excellent work without creating friction, take ownership without needing applause, and genuinely celebrate when a teammate wins.

High Performance. Zero Drama. Peaceful & Profitable — we mean all three.



If you’re the person who already did the job before anyone asked — this was written for you.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: IMMEDIATE HIRE – Executive Assistant to CEO - Full Time (Long-Term)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Executive Assistant to work directly with the CEO in a full-time, long-term role (1+ year).



Attention to detail is the heart of this role. We need someone who reads carefully, follows instructions exactly, and double-checks their own work. If precision energizes you rather than annoys you, you will fit right in.



This role is for an A-player. You are comfortable working directly with a driven CEO who values speed, precision, and accountability. You will play a critical part in supporting the CEO’s day-to-day operations, communications, lead coordination, and organizational priorities. You must be proactive, able to anticipate needs without prompting, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. You do not wait for instructions when priorities are unclear; you seek clarity and move forward. The right candidate manages multiple priorities without dropping details and maintains strict discretion.



We work closely and move quickly, so being reliably present makes a real difference. We trust you to maintain a work setup that lets you show up at your best: clear on video, smooth screen sharing, and no technical interruptions during meetings or deadlines. The choice of tools is yours, as long as they keep you fully present and productive.



Working hours are Monday through Friday during Pacific Time Zone business hours. Occasionally, irregular hours may be required during project deadlines or travel periods.







Role Mission & Outcomes



Mission



The Executive Assistant serves as a strategic force multiplier to the CEO, ensuring his time, attention, and energy are focused on the highest-leverage priorities.



The mission of this role is to reduce executive friction, increase decision velocity, and proactively manage the flow of information, commitments, and priorities around the CEO.



Outcomes:



- The CEO’s calendar, calls, and travel are structured and executed without friction.

- Leads, deals, and follow-ups are tracked and organized with no missed commitments.

- Community inquiries and issues are handled promptly and escalated appropriately.

- Executive communications are polished, accurate, and prepared in advance.

- Key deadlines, logistics, and cross-team coordination are visible and proactively managed to prevent slippage.

- Research is delivered in clear, concise summaries that support timely executive decision-making.

- Project logistics and scheduling are coordinated without last-minute disruption.

- Cross-team coordination is maintained so initiatives progress without executive intervention.



Core Responsibilities



Executive & Administrative Support



- Own and structure the CEO’s calendar to maximize focus and efficiency

- Coordinate meetings with clear preparation, agendas, and follow-ups

- Plan and execute travel logistics, including contingencies and documentation

- Maintain highly organized documentation and file systems to ensure clarity and rapid retrieval



Lead Coordination & Executive Support



- Track and manage CEO-owned leads and deal flow to ensure timely follow-up

- Coordinate scheduling and logistics for calls and meetings with the CEO’s leads

- Maintain organized records, notes, and follow-ups for CEO-managed communications

- Prepare the CEO for calls with organized notes, context, and clear objectives



Community Support & Management



- Assist with community building and management of the company’s online community platform

- Monitor community activity and ensure members receive timely responses

- Escalate important matters or opportunities to the CEO when necessary



Executive Communication & Content Support



- Draft executive communications on behalf of the CEO with minimal direction when appropriate

- Proofread
s and communications to ensure clarity, professionalism, and accuracy

- Conduct research to support executive initiatives, communications, or projects



Research, Logistics, & Project Coordination



- Research services, vendors, tools, or solutions as needed

- Coordinate scheduling, consultations, and logistics for various projects

- Proactively track project progress and surface risks before they impact timelines

- Maintain visibility on key deadlines and enforce follow-through across commitments



---



Requirements



- Minimum 2 years experience as an Executive Assistant or similar role

- C2 Level English proficiency (please attach copy of your certificate when applying)

- Strong written English and ability to draft and edit professional communications

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex schedules and competing priorities without dropping details

- Consistently produces accurate work with minimal oversight

- Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and act without constant direction

- Able to execute tasks accurately while proactively seeking clarification when needed

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-performance environment

- Emotionally mature and able to remain steady under pressure

- Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion and maintain strict confidentiality at all times

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) and ability to leverage them effectively is preferred

- In the job application form, please enter “99” as your age

- Receptive to direct feedback and committed to continuous improvement, operating under high performance expectations

description:
Wealthrive is a consulting startup dedicated to empowering high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, and families to achieve financial freedom and create enduring legacies. As the sister company to Freedom Family Office (
), a fully virtual firm built by entrepreneurs for entrepreneurs, we provide holistic services that encompass strategic wealth management, personalized consulting, and famiexcly office solutions. Together, our mission is to help clients become "Rich Beyond Money" and build lives rooted in financial security, purpose, and impact.



Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have at least 5-7 years of accounting experience, particularly in a BPO setting for a U.S.-based company. This role requires a strong understanding of Philippine tax and payroll regulations to ensure compliance with local laws and supporting U.S. business operations. The Accountant will be responsible for managing accounting functions, including tax calculations, payroll processing, and financial reporting. This position is based on US ET time zone which is equivalent to 9PM-6AM PH time Monday to Friday.



Key Responsibilities:

• Perform day-to-day accounting tasks, including but not limited to accounts payable/receivable, general ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations.

• Process payroll in accordance with Philippine tax and labor laws, ensuring accurate deductions, contributions, and timely disbursements.

• Prepare and file taxes, including withholding tax, VAT, and other statutory contributions, ensuring compliance with Philippine tax laws in coordination with the firm’s external accountant.

• Assist with the preparation of monthly and yearly financial statements, ensuring timely and accurate reporting for US and PH entities.

• Supervise staff accountant.

• Manage accounts, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with U.S. accounting principles and standards.

• Coordinate with U.S. teams on financial matters, ensuring smooth financial operations across different time zones.

• Handle year-end accounting tasks, including audit preparation and tax return filing.

• Ensure compliance with Philippine tax and payroll regulations, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of any changes or updates in legislation.

 

• Collaborate with the management team to identify process improvements, streamline accounting workflows, and improve efficiency.

• Provide support during internal and external audits, ensuring all necessary documentation is in order.

• Other tasks as required by management such as but not limited to equipment inventory, occasional recruitment activities, and basic office management.



Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

• At least 5-7 years of accounting experience, with a strong preference for candidates with experience in a BPO environment supporting U.S. businesses.

• In-depth knowledge of Philippine tax laws, payroll requirements, and statutory compliance.

• Strong familiarity with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

• Proficient in Quickbooks and MS Office particularly Excel.

• Proven ability to work independently with little supervision. Showing initiative in getting things done is a key aspect t this position.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Having high-level accounting experience such as budgeting and forecasting is appreciated.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams in different time zones.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• CPA or other relevant accounting certifications is a plus but not required.

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn and have the ability to work well with others.



Why Join Us?

• Opportunity to work in a dynamic and fast-growing company.

• Competitive salary and benefits.

• Collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

• Work with a team of skilled professionals, supporting U.S.-based operations.

title: Data Operations Specialist
description:

This is an independent remote contractor role with a UK-based company.



About Ocula:

Ocula is one of the world’s leading platforms for discovering contemporary art, connecting collectors with leading galleries, artists, and exhibitions globally. We combine editorial expertise, advisory services, and technology to build one of the industry’s richest structured datasets on contemporary art.



As we continue to invest in AI-assisted workflows, we are looking for a trusted partner or individual to support a key operational function within our data pipeline.



The opportunity:

Ocula receives hundreds of exhibition and art fair previews from leading galleries around the world. These previews contain artwork images and valuable metadata, including artist names, titles, dimensions, medium, pricing, and exhibition information.



Our proprietary AI platform extracts this information automatically. Your role is to review, validate, and correct the AI output before it is published into Ocula’s artwork database.



This is not traditional data entry. AI performs the initial extraction, while your role is to ensure the final dataset is complete, accurate, and consistently structured.



Responsibilities:



Review AI-generated artwork data against the original gallery preview (PDF or web page).

Correct metadata, images, and formatting where required.

Ensure all records meet Ocula’s quality standards before publication.

Prioritise work according to exhibition opening dates and major international art fairs.

Identify recurring AI extraction errors and communicate patterns to our product team to improve future automation.

Work within Ocula’s proprietary CMS and follow documented workflows and quality guidelines.



What we’re looking for:



We’re looking for people who are,

Exceptionally detail-oriented.

Comfortable working with AI-assisted workflows.

title: Recruiting Manager - US Healthcare Staffing - Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type: Full-Time | Pay: $1,400–$1,800/month base (experience-based, night differential included) + monthly performance commission | Hours: 40/week | Schedule: Fixed US night shift, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST, Mon–Fri



About the Role



A US-based healthcare direct-hire staffing firm is looking for a Recruiting Manager to lead delivery for our lean, offshore recruiting team. This is not a "carry your own req" role — you'll own the funnel and the people: screening, quality control, coaching, and turning pipeline into client submissions every week. All clients and placed candidates are US-based; this is a fully remote, Philippines-based leadership seat with real authority.



You'll inherit a team already supported by AI systems that handle sourcing, list-building, outreach, and daily worklists. Your job is the part that AI can't do: screening candidates at volume, enforcing quality, coaching your recruiters, and hitting our delivery standard of 15 screened submissions per week across the team.



What You'll Own



Delivery: every submission is recruiter-screened with license/credential verification completed before it goes out — no exceptions. You're accountable for the submit-to-interview ratio and time-to-fill.



People: direct management of a Senior Recruiter and appointment setter(s), growing to a 3–5 person pod — onboarding, weekly coaching through call reviews, performance management, and making tough calls on underperformers when needed.



Cadence: running daily standups against AI-generated worklists — the day's screens, submits, and follow-ups are queued each morning; you drive execution.



Reporting: a weekly KPI scorecard to the owner covering submissions, interviews, placements, and per-recruiter production — pulled straight from the ATS.





What You Bring



-Four or more years of US healthcare staffing experience on the agency side, personally recruiting US healthcare professionals (allied health/imaging, nursing, or physicians), including direct-hire/permanent placement work.

-At least one year directly managing recruiters or sourcers — assigning reqs, owning their numbers, coaching them, and holding them accountable (not just mentoring peers).

-Fluency with recruiting metrics — you can speak confidently, fro
mory, about what strong weekly production looks like (submissions, interview rate, placements) and what your own team has delivered.

-Strong spoken English, since you'll run standups, coach recruiters live, and occasionally speak with US clients. A recorded voice sample and live spoken interview are part of our process.

-The ability to commit long-term to the fixed US night shift (8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST) with a reliable home setup: quiet space, headset, stable internet, and backup power/data.

-Comfort working in an ATS (Manatal or similar) alongside AI-driven sourcing and outreach tools.



Compensation & Growth



$1,400–$1,800/month base depending on experience, plus monthly performance commission tied to team placements — the better your pod performs, the more you earn (specifics discussed at offer). Paid reliably and on time via Wise. 



This is a long-term seat with genuine authority: input on hiring, performance management, and a direct line to the owner. Clear growth path from Recruiting Manager to Head of Delivery as the team scales.



This Role Is a Strong Fit If You...



-Have hands-on US healthcare staffing/recruiting agency experience (not PH-local or non-US recruiting). 

-Have directly managed recruiters — and can speak to your team's real numbers. 

-Have led in a recruiting context specifically, not BPO customer service, collections, or support. 

-Can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with answers to the following. Applications missing the resume or any of the six answers will not be reviewed:



1. Your US healthcare staffing experience — agency name(s), years at each, which US healthcare roles you recruited, and the split between direct-hire/permanent vs. travel/contract work.



2. The team you led — how many recruiters/sourcers reported directly to you, for how long, and one real example of managing an underperformer (what you did, week by week, and the outcome).



3. Your team's numbers for one recent normal month — submissions per recruiter/week, submit-to-interview %, and placements — plus your own personal production numbers from when you carried a desk.



4. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording explaining how you'd run a 5-person US healthcare recruiting desk to 15 screened submissions/week, including your standup approach, the 3 KPIs you'd track, how you'd enforce screen quality, and your own production numbers stated out loud. This is the most important part of your application.



5. Confirmation you can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term, plus your home setup details (internet speed, headset, quiet space, backup power/internet).



6. Your current or most recent monthly pay and your earliest possible start date.

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:
# Job Title: Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager- Minimum 7 years of experience required, and willing to work Eastern Standard Time; responsible, reliable, able to deliver results, and has worked exclusively on Amazon Seller Central. Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management



* Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central, excluding PPC.

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



  * Amazon SEO and listing structure

  * Parent-child variations

  * Flat files and bulk uploads

  * Listing suppression issues

  * Inventory file templates

  * Seller Central troubleshooting

  * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Strong understanding of how listing images, A+ content, and brand storytelling affect conversion.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Catalog issues, suppressed listings, and operational problems are resolved quickly and proactively.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

* Product launches and updates are executed accurately and efficiently.

* The Amazon storefront reflects a polished, premium European home décor brand experience.



## To Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction outlining your Amazon Seller Central experience.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

4. Any experience working with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or lifestyle brands.

5. Your availability and preferred compensation structure.



## Important Note



This role is **not for PPC or advertising management**. We are specifically seeking an Amazon professional who excels in **listing management, catalog optimization, and overall Seller Central account management**.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (Meta/IG/YouTube Ads) — AI-Native
description:
ABOUT US



A Man & His Cave is one of Australia's leading man cave and lifestyle brands. We sell pool tables, arcade machines, pinball machines, kegerators, furniture, and bar accessories to blokes building the ultimate setup, nationwide.



Our ads are anti-corporate, direct, and made to convert. They should feel like a mate showing off his cave, not a polished SaaS demo. If that sounds like your kind of edit, keep reading.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This role directly impacts revenue. You won't just edit videos, you'll craft high-performing direct response ads that drive measurable sales across
, Instagram, and YouTube.



We're looking for a skilled Video Editor with real direct response experience. You understand ad hooks, retention, pacing for performance, and how to edit for conversions, not just aesthetics. You'll start at around 20 hours per week, and if your edits perform, you move to full-time within 30 days. Applicants should be ready and willing to scale up fast.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit high-converting short-form direct response ads (1 to 3 per day) for paid social

- Structure every ad using a clear hook, problem, solution, proof, offer framework

- Cut for a scroll-stopping hook in the first 3 seconds

- Produce multiple variations for A/B testing

- Add captions, motion graphics, and dynamic text overlays

- Repurpose long-form footage into short-form performance ads

- Format and export creatives for each platform's specs and aspect ratios

- Iterate fast based on feedback and performance data

- Keep raw footage, assets, and project files organised and clean

- Collaborate with media buyers and copywriters to align creative with strategy



REQUIRED TOOLS



You should be proficient in most of these:

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects

- CapCut or similar short-form tools

- Canva for quick graphic overlays

- Google Drive, Slack, Asana

title: Mid-level Salesforce Marketing Cloud & CRM Developer
description:
What is this role?

As a Mid-level Salesforce Marketing Cloud & CRM Developer at Comet CX, you'll deliver quality technical implementation independently within an agreed solution direction, working closely with our Architects and CX Consultants across our Australian and Manila teams. You'll take assigned implementation tasks from design through to a well-documented, quality-assured build — raising questions early when direction is unclear rather than assuming — and contribute practical build input into architect-led designs.



Much of our current work sits where marketing meets the core platform: activating Salesforce Data Cloud over CRM data, orchestrating journeys with Salesforce Flow on Marketing Cloud Next, and running these alongside existing Marketing Cloud Engagement and Account Engagement (Pardot) estates. This role suits a developer comfortable moving between marketing automation and CRM — because on Marketing Cloud Next, they are the same platform. As a mid-level tea
mber, you'll also support team capability by mentoring junior developers through peer review and day-to-day guidance. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



Solution Development & Customisation — Contribute to tailored solutions across Marketing Cloud Next, Marketing Cloud Engagement, and Salesforce CRM, including personalised customer experiences.

CRM Configuration & Development — Build and configure Sales Cloud and Service Cloud solutions, including objects, flows, validation rules, and Apex/LWC customisations where required.

Journey Orchestration & Automation — Design and build automated customer journeys: campaign and segment-triggered Flows on Marketing Cloud Next, and Journey Builder / Automation Studio automations for Marketing Cloud Engagement clients.

Data Cloud Configuration & Segmentation — Support Data Cloud (Data 360) implementation work: connecting CRM sources, harmonising data into the Data Cloud model (DLOs to DMOs), building calculated insights, and creating segments activated to journeys and advertising platforms.

Campaign Design & Content — Assist in designing and managing multi-channel campaigns across
 and SMS, building reusable
 templates, content-block libraries, and token- or AMPscript-based personalisation as the platform requires.

Migration & Parallel-Run Delivery — Support clients transitioning from Account Engagement (Pardot) to Marketing Cloud Next, including parallel-run delivery where both platforms operate side by side.

AI & Agentforce — Use Agentforce and Einstein capabilities to accelerate campaign creation, content generation, and audience building, and help clients adopt agentic marketing workflows.

System Integration — Assist in integrating marketing and CRM platforms with ERP and third-party systems, ensuring seamless data connectivity and troubleshooting data-sync issues across connected systems.

Reporting, Insights & Optimisation — Support A/B testing, build campaign and attribution reporting using calculated insights and native Salesforce reports and dashboards, and surface data-led recommendations that improve client outcomes and ROI.

Client Collaboration & Training — Work alongside senior tea
mbers to support client engagements, understand marketing and business objectives, and contribute to training and enablement sessions.

Mentorship & Peer Review — Support the development of junior developers through active peer review, using it as a teaching tool for them and a learning tool for yourself.

Documentation & Compliance — Contribute to technical documentation for solutions and integrations, ensuring adherence to data protection regulations and industry best practices.

Continuous Learning — Actively grow your knowledge across the Salesforce marketing portfolio — Marketing Cloud Next, Marketing Cloud Engagement, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, Account Engagement, Personalization, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud — and take ownership of your professional development.



Who are we looking for?

We're looking for a mid-level Salesforce developer with genuine experience across marketing automation and CRM who can own the delivery of assigned work independently, with minimal oversight, while continuing to grow within a collaborative, client-facing environment. Because Marketing Cloud Next is built on the core platform, strong Flow and core-platform skills matter as much as classic Marketing Cloud experience — we'll help you bridge whichever side you're stronger on.



We're looking for a candidate who brings the following to the table:

3+ years working with the Salesforce platform, spanning marketing automation (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Account Engagement, or Marketing Cloud Next) and CRM (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), delivering implementation work independently to quality standards

Strong, hands-on Salesforce Flow skills, with working knowledge of Apex and LWC

A solid understanding of marketing data and segmentation concepts, with the judgment to raise questions early when a solution direction is unclear

Good communication skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, can-do approach to problem-solving — including a root-cause mentality rather than just addressing symptoms

At least one relevant Salesforce certification (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Data Cloud / Data 360 Consultant, Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant or Developer, or Agentforce Specialist) is preferred, though a genuine drive to certify further will also be considered

The following would make a candidate stand out, though they're not essential:

Hands-on exposure to Marketing Cloud Next (Growth or Advanced editions) or Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360)

Experience with Account Engagement (Pardot) — several of our current engagements involve activating Marketing Cloud Next alongside existing Pardot estates

Exposure to Agentforce or Personalization

Exposure to Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Prior experience mentoring or peer-reviewing junior developers

Prior experience in a consulting, managed services, or CX-focused organisation

Understanding of how to get the best value from AI tools, including prompt engineering and context engineering



What can Comet CX offer?

As a young, growing business, you will be exposed to a wide variety of customers and technical challenges. No two days will be the same. You'll work at the front edge of the Salesforce marketing stack — Marketing Cloud Next is new to market, and you'll build real delivery experience on it that very few developers have.

We are offering a generous salary based on your level of experience.



Is this role right for you?

We'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and optional cover letter to

We are seeking an experienced **Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist** to lead the growth and day-to-day management of our Etsy shop specializing in **premium European-inspired home décor**. Our collection includes **tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and Afghan-style home textiles**, with a focus on craftsmanship, storytelling, and elevated presentation.



This role is ideal for a professional who understands how to grow an Etsy store strategically—not just maintain listings, but actively increase traffic, conversion, average order value, and repeat purchases while preserving a premium brand image.



### About the Brand



We are a premium home décor business offering beautifully designed textile and decorative products for customers who appreciate timeless, elegant interiors. Our products include:



* Tapestries and wall hangings

* Cushion covers and decorative pillow covers

* Table runners and table linens

* Afghan throws and woven home accessories

* Other premium home décor textiles and accessories



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our Etsy store and help turn it into a stronger, more consistent sales channel.



### Key Responsibilities



**Etsy Store Growth & Sales Generation**



* Develop and execute a clear strategy to grow Etsy store revenue, traffic, and conversion rates

* Optimize the Etsy storefront for sales performance, customer experience, and premium brand presentation

* Identify opportunities to improve click-through rate, conversion rate, average order value, and repeat customer purchases

* Build promotional strategies around seasonal demand, holidays, gifting, home décor trends, and product launches

* Recommend pricing, bundling, and merchandising strategies to improve profitability and sales 
ntum

* Monitor competitors, market trends, keyword opportunities, and product positioning within the premium home décor category



**Listing Optimization & Merchandising**



* Create, optimize, and manage product listings for Etsy SEO and customer conversion

* Write compelling, high-converting titles, descriptions, product highlights, and storytelling-driven copy aligned with a premium brand voice

* Improve product presentation through strong listing structure, keyword strategy, and merchandising logic

* Advise on listing images, mockups, lifestyle content, video, and other visual elements that can improve conversion

* Organize product collections, cross-sell opportunities, and shop sections to enhance browsing and basket size



**Store Management & Daily Operations**



* Manage the day-to-day performance and upkeep of the Etsy store

* Ensure listings are accurate, complete, and updated for inventory, pricing, attributes, shipping settings, and policies

* Monitor shop health, customer experience, reviews, response times, and order-related issues

* Coordinate with the business owner/team regarding new products, stock updates, promotions, and priorities

* Maintain consistency in product presentation, brand messaging, and customer communication



**Analytics, Reporting & Performance Improvement**



* Track Etsy store performance and provide regular reporting on key KPIs such as:



  * Revenue growth

  * Conversion rate

  * Etsy traffic and traffic sources

  * Click-through rate

  * Best-selling products and underperforming listings

  * Return on promotions and campaigns

  * Average order value

* Use data to identify what is working, what is underperforming, and where action is needed

* Make proactive recommendations to improve store performance month over month



### Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who has a proven ability to **grow Etsy sales for product-based brands**, ideally within **home décor, textiles, interiors, gifts, lifestyle products, or premium handcrafted/elevated consumer goods**.



**Requirements**



* Proven experience managing and growing Etsy stores with measurable sales results

* Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, ranking factors, merchandising, and conversion optimization

* Experience writing compelling product listings and titles that balance keyword strategy with premium brand positioning

* Strong eye for product presentation, merchandising, and customer-facing storytelling

* Ability to analyze store performance and translate data into actionable growth strategies

* Experience with premium, design-led, lifestyle, or home décor brands is strongly preferred

* Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of store performance

* Excellent written English and communication skills



### What Success Looks Like in This Role



The right candidate will help us:



* Grow Etsy store revenue consistently

* Improve conversion rates across key product listings

* Strengthen the premium positioning of our shop

* Build a more polished, strategic, and high-performing Etsy presence

* Turn Etsy into a dependable and scalable sales channel for our home décor brand



### To Apply

1. A short introduction about your Etsy experience

2. Examples of Etsy stores or brands you have managed

3. Specific results you achieved (sales growth, conversion improvements, SEO wins, etc.)

4. Your approach to growing a premium home décor Etsy store

title: Remote Driver Performance Coach & Performance Analyst
description:
We are looking for a proactive, people-focused Remote Driver Performance Coach who can combine 1-on-1 coaching, performance data analysis, and process improvement to help delivery drivers become better performers.



The goal is simple: help drivers improve.



This role requires someone who is equally comfortable talking to people and working with data. You will analyze driver performance, identify individual gaps, conduct personalized Zoom coaching sessions, and turn operational SOPs into simple, practical best practices that drivers can actually follow.



Key Responsibilities

Conduct regular 1-on-1 Zoom coaching sessions with drivers.

Proactively contact drivers and schedule sessions around their work schedules and days off.

Analyze driver performance data using Excel/XLS files, pivot tables, filters, charts, rankings, and trend analysis.

Identify recurring performance gaps and determine which drivers need immediate coaching.

Translate data into clear coaching: explain what went wrong, why it matters, and exactly what the driver should do differently.

Learn company and operational SOPs, policies, scorecards, and performance standards.

Draft and maintain simple SOPs, coaching guides, checklists, and driver best-practice documents based on official procedures.

Convert complex SOPs into short, practical instructions that drivers can understand and apply on the road.

Document write ups and individual improvement plans and follow up to measure whether coaching resulted in improvement.

Maintain detailed coaching notes and performance trackers.

Identify trends across the driver population and recommend group coaching or training topics.

Recognize improvement and motivate drivers while maintaining clear accountability.

Communicate recurring driver challenges, performance risks, and improvement opportunities to leadership.

Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, analytical thinker, and natural coach. You should be able to build trust with drivers while also being comfortable reviewing numbers, identifying patterns, and giving clear performance feedback.



Strong Excel skills are important. You should be comfortable working with large spreadsheets, sorting and filtering data, creating pivot tables, identifying trends, and turning data into actionable coaching.



Experience in Last-mile delivery, logistics, driver coaching, quality assurance, training, performance management, or operational analytics is strongly preferred.



You must be comfortable conducting video calls with U.S.-based employees and have significant working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT). The role requires reliable high-speed internet, strong spoken and written English, and flexibility to coach drivers based on their availability.



The right person understands that data tells us where the problem is, but good coaching helps us fix it.



To apply: Tell us about your coaching experience, Excel and data-analysis skills, experience creating SOPs or training materials, any delivery operations experience, and your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time, ability to conduct zoom calls per driver availability.

title: Canva Brand Content Production Specialist — Weekly 48-Piece Gig
description:

TYPE OF WORK

The contractor turns these supplied materials into accurate, polished, properly presented content packages.



WEEKLY PRODUCTION BATCH

-only brand carousels

 post graphics

• 6 founder-profile
 Story graphics

Individual carousel slides are not counted separately. Each carousel is one multi-slide content piece.



COMPLETE DELIVERABLE STANDARD



A content piece is not considered complete until all required companion materials have been properly packaged.



Depending on the assigned format, the completed package may include:



• Final exported visual files

• Complete carousel slide set

• Hashtag set

• SEO keyword phrase

• Metadata

• Alt text

• First-comment instructions

• Correct file name

• Correct dimensions

• Correct version number

• Correct Google Drive folder placement



All required visual files and sidecar information are included in the quoted batch price.



PRODUCTION WORKFLOW



1. Review the assigned weekly blog.



2. Review the production brief and the specific content angle assigned to each deliverable.



3. Pull the corresponding company-provided artifact outputs, including panel copy, caption, CTA, hashtags, SEO phrase, metadata, alt text, and first-comment instructions.



4. Match the correct artifact output to the correct brand, platform, and content piece.



5. Select an approved photograph or video that supports the assigned blog angle and content.



6. Duplicate the correct locked Canva template.



7. Place the approved visual and supplied content into the template.



8. Apply the brand’s established palette, typography, layout, panel, cropping, and language rules.



9. Assemble all carousel slides or individual graphics required for the assigned content piece.



10. Prepare the required caption sidecar and companion information.



11. Complete the quality-control checklist.



12. Export, name, organize, and deliver the complete content package.



PHOTO-FIRST VISUAL RULE



The assigned blog, production brief, and company-provided artifact package establish the content.



Photo-first applies to the visual execution.



After reviewing the assigned content, the contractor selects an approved photograph or video that genuinely supports the blog angle. That visual then guides the crop, composition, and emotional presentation of the finished design.





MEDIA PROVIDED



Approved visual sources include:



• Approved UGC submissions

• Founder-shot iPhone photographs and videos

• Images provided with the weekly blog

• Storyblocks licensed photographs and videos

• Artgrid licensed photographs and videos



The contractor is expected to select the strongest approved visual for each assigned piece.



100% AI-FREE VISUAL-DESIGN POLICY



All visual design must be 100% AI-free.



The following may not be used:



• AI-generated photographs

• AI-generated videos

• AI-generated backgrounds

• AI-generated graphic elements

• Text-to-image tools

• Generative fill

• Generative expand

• Canva Magic Media

• AI-generated composites

• AI-generated replacement photography

• Any other generative visual-design feature



Only approved photography, supplied media, locked templates, and standard non-generative editing may be used.



The company may provide copy and metadata generated through its internal content artifacts. This does not authorize generative AI use in the visual-design process.



DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS



• The complete weekly batch is due Wednesday at 8:00 am Pacific Time.

• Revisions are completed between Thursday and Friday.

• The final corrected pass must be completed by Saturday at 8:00 am Pacific Time.

• Faster completion is welcomed.

• Review may begin as soon as the entire batch is submitted.

• Partial batches do not begin the formal review process.

• Multiple revisions are included until the work meets the original production brief and brand standards.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience using Google Drive

• Ability to follow detailed instructions and brand standards

• Willingness to comply with the 100% AI-free visual-design policy



PAID PRACTICAL TEST

• Communication and delivery reliability



HOW TO APPLY

PHOTO FIRST

2. A link to your portfolio.



3. Three examples of multi-slide social-media carousels.

 graphics.

Job Title: Enrollment Specialist, Intake Coordinator, Patient Care Coordinator, New Client Coordinator



Location: Virtual

Employment Type: Full-Time 



About the Job

Pacific Mind Health is an established outpatient mental health practice seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and compassionate professional to join our virtual team. We are committed to providing a patient-centered healthcare experience built on respect, integrity, teamwork, and exceptional service.



As a Patient Intake & Care Coordinator, you will play a critical role in helping patients access care by supporting the new patient journey from initial inquiry through scheduling and onboarding. This position requires strong communication skills (English), attention to detail, and the ability to provide a professional and compassionate experience for patients seeking mental health services.



Your work will directly support timely access to high-quality care by ensuring accurate patient enrollment, efficient scheduling, insurance verification, and seamless coordination between patients, providers, and internal teams.



This is a full-time remote position, working Monday through Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. Candidates must be available during Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours.



Key Responsibilities

•  Conduct new patient screenings and intake assessments (mental health experience required).

•  Serve as the first point of contact for prospective and new patients, providing a welcoming and supportive experience.

•  Communicate with patients regarding available services, including Interventional Psychiatry treatments such as TMS and Spravato.

•  Gather and accurately document patient demographic, clinical, and insurance information.

•  Coordinate and schedule initial consultations, follow-up appointments, and procedures.

•  Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage requirements, and financial responsibilities.

•  Review and collect required patient intake forms, consent forms, and supporting documentation.

•  Follow up with patients regarding incomplete paperwork, missing information, or outstanding requirements.

•  Assist patients with questions regarding practice policies, procedures, services, and next steps in their care journey.

•  Collaborate closely with clinical and administrative teams to ensure efficient patient transitions and high-quality care coordination.

•  Maintain accurate records within electronic medical record (EMR) systems and related platforms.

•  Support improvements to intake workflows, scheduling processes, and overall patient experience.

•  Perform additional administrative responsibilities as assigned.



Qualifications

•  3+ years of recent mental health medical office experience required.

•  Minimum of 1 year of experience in patient intake, enrollment, care coordination, or new patient onboarding.

•  Licensed nurse or clinical healthcare background preferred.

•  Experience with mental health services, psychiatric practices, or specialty healthcare settings strongly preferred.

•  Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

•  Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

•  Ability to provide compassionate, professional, and patient-focused experience.

•  Reliable high-speed internet connection required.



Additional Skills & Competencies

•  Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written (English) communication with patients, providers, and external vendors through phone,
, and virtual platforms.

•  Patient Experience: Ability to build trust with patients, explain processes clearly, and provide support throughout the intake and scheduling experience.

•  Self-Motivation & Accountability: Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working independently as part of a remote healthcare team.

•  Organization & Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and maintain accuracy while handling multiple patient requests.

•  Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using:

•  Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems (e.g., Tebra, Kipu, DrChrono)

•  Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

description:

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract (Initial 6–12-month project with long-term opportunity)



About the Project



We are building what we believe will become the world’s leading AI-powered precious metals intelligence platform.



Every week, thousands of hours of content are published across YouTube, X, Reddit, LinkedIn, podcasts, research papers, mining company announcements and financial news. Our mission is to build an autonomous AI research engine that continuously collects, analyses, verifies and distils this information into actionable intelligence for investors.



This is not another newsletter.



This is an AI-first intelligence platform designed to operate like a digital research department.



We are looking for an exceptional AI Automation & Intelligence Systems Architect to design and build the entire platform from the ground up.



The Mission

Continuously scrape and monitor thousands of trusted information sources.

Monitor YouTube channels, podcasts and livestreams.

Transcribe and analyse video and audio content.

Collect and classify social media content from X, Reddit, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.

Download and analyse company announcements from ASX, SGX, TSX, SEC and other exchanges.

Monitor macroeconomic data, commodities, ETF flows, COMEX, LBMA and economic releases.

Detect emerging themes and changing market sentiment.

Eliminate duplicate information and identify original insights.

Rank stories by importance and confidence.

Automatically generate executive summaries, research reports, newsletters and social media content.

Create AI agents that continuously improve the system over time.

What You'll Build

AI research agents.

What Success Looks Like



Within the first six months, you will have built a platform capable of:



Monitoring more than 5,000 trusted information sources.

Processing hundreds of videos each week.

Analysing tens of thousands of social media posts.

Automatically classifying and ranking information.

Detecting emerging market trends before they become mainstream.

Producing executive-quality intelligence reports with minimal human intervention.

Generating newsletters, research reports, video scripts and social media content from a single automated workflow.

The Person We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems and building systems that scale.



You are curious, technically excellent and comfortable working across AI, automation, data engineering and product development. You don't wait for instructions—you design, build, test and improve.



You understand that the goal is not simply to automate tasks, but to create an intelligence platform that delivers measurable value through speed, accuracy and insight.



Why Join Us?



This is an opportunity to build a category-defining AI platform from the ground up.



The architecture developed for the precious metals market will become the foundation for additional intelligence platforms covering critical minerals, AI, cryptocurrency, energy and global macroeconomics.

nts that land: emotion, reactions, punchlines, the awkward and viral beats

nt starts, builds and pays off, this isn't the job for you.

title: Amazon Store Manager / E-Commerce Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for an experienced, reliable, and detail-oriented **Amazon Store Manager / Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines** to manage our Amazon store from end to end.



The ideal candidate should be able to independently handle daily Amazon operations, product listings, inventory monitoring, customer service, account health, advertising coordination, reporting, and issue resolution. This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands Amazon Seller Central and can proactively identify problems, recommend solutions, and help grow the business.



## Key Responsibilities



### Seller Central Management



* Manage the Amazon Seller Central account on a daily basis.

* Monitor account health, performance notifications, policy warnings, and compliance issues.

* Open and follow up on Seller Support cases until they are resolved.

* Track suppressed, stranded, inactive, and blocked listings.

* Monitor Voice of the Customer, customer experience metrics, and listing-related issues.

* Maintain organized records of cases, reimbursements, listing changes, and operational problems.



### Product Listing Management



* Create and optimize product listings, including titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, and backend search terms.

* Create and manage product variations, parent-child relationships, and listing updates.

* Upload products using inventory templates and flat files.

* Troubleshoot listing errors, catalog conflicts, duplicate listings, and variation issues.

* Coordinate product images, videos, A+ Content, and Brand Store updates.

* Conduct keyword and competitor research to improve listing visibility and conversion.



### Inventory and Order Management



* Monitor FBA and FBM inventory levels.

* Prepare inventory forecasts and restocking recommendations.

* Create and manage FBA shipment plans.

* Track inbound shipments, receiving discrepancies, lost inventory, damaged inventory, and stranded inventory.

* Monitor storage limits, aged inventory, excess inventory, and inventory performance.

* Coordinate with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and fulfillment partners.

* Monitor customer orders, cancellations, returns, refunds, and replacements.



### Customer Service



* Respond professionally to permitted customer communications within Amazon’s response-time requirements.

* Handle delivery issues, damaged items, replacements, refunds, and product-related concerns.

* Monitor customer feedback, product reviews, return reasons, and common complaints.

* Escalate product quality concerns and recommend corrective actions.

* Follow all Amazon communication and customer-service policies.



### Account Health and Compliance



* Monitor Account Health Rating and performance metrics.

* Respond to policy violations, intellectual property complaints, restricted-product issues, and listing deactivations.

* Assist with Plans of Action and appeals by gathering documentation and identifying root causes.

* Maintain organized supplier invoices, authorization letters, product documentation, and compliance records.

* Ensure listings and business practices comply with Amazon policies.

* Immediately report serious account risks or potential suspension issues.



### Amazon Advertising and Promotions



* Monitor Amazon PPC campaigns and basic advertising performance.

* Review search-term reports, keyword performance, advertising cost of sales, and return on advertising spend.

* Identify irrelevant or unprofitable search terms and recommend negative keywords.

* Coordinate coupons, promotions, pricing updates, and deals.

* Work with the owner or advertising specialist to improve campaign profitability.



### Financial Monitoring and Reimbursements



* Review Amazon settlement reports, fees, refunds, chargebacks, and deductions.

* Identify possible FBA reimbursement opportunities involving lost, damaged, or incorrectly received inventory.

* Open and follow up on reimbursement cases.

* Monitor storage fees, return fees, fulfillment fees, and other Amazon charges.

* Prepare clear reports identifying financial discrepancies and recommended actions.



### Reporting and Business Improvement



* Provide daily or weekly reports covering:



  * Sales and revenue

  * Advertising performance

  * Inventory levels

  * Account health

  * Returns and customer complaints

  * Open Seller Support cases

  * Listing problems

  * Reimbursements

  * Recommended actions

* Maintain organized trackers using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

* Identify opportunities to increase sales, reduce costs, improve listings, and prevent operational issues.

* Create and document standard operating procedures for recurring Amazon tasks.

* Provide proactive updates rather than waiting to be asked.



## Required Qualifications



* Minimum 2 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.

* Experience managing an Amazon store with FBA and, preferably, FBM products.

* Strong understanding of Amazon listings, flat files, variations, inventory, orders, returns, and account health.

* Experience opening and resolving Amazon Seller Support cases.

* Familiarity with Amazon advertising, keyword research, and listing optimization.

* Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

* Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently with limited supervision.

* Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and backup internet or power solution.

* Ability to protect confidential company, supplier, customer, and financial information.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with some of the following tools is preferred:



* Helium 10

* Jungle Scout

* Keepa

* SellerAmp

* Canva

* ChatGPT or other AI productivity tools

* Inventory management software

* Amazon Brand Registry

* A+ Content

* Amazon Storefronts

* eBay, Walmart Marketplace, Shopify, or TikTok Shop



## Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be evaluated based on:



* Timely resolution of Amazon cases and listing issues.

* Accuracy of product listings and inventory records.

* Prevention of stockouts and excess inventory.

* Improvement in account health and customer-experience metrics.

* Responsiveness and quality of communication.

* Accuracy and usefulness of weekly reports.

* Ability to identify and resolve problems proactively.

* Contribution to sales growth, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.



## Work Schedule



The selected candidate must be available during [insert required hours] and should be able to attend scheduled meetings during U.S. Central Time when required.



Occasional availability may be needed for urgent account-health, listing, inventory, or customer-service issues.



## Application Instructions



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A brief description of your Amazon Seller Central experience.

3. The number and types of Amazon stores you have managed.

4. The Amazon tasks you can complete without supervision.

5. The tools you have used, such as Helium 10, Keepa, SellerAmp, or Jungle Scout.

6. An example of a difficult Amazon issue you resolved.

7. Your expected monthly salary.

8. Your preferred working hours.

9. Your internet speed and backup internet or power arrangement.

10. A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit for this position.



Please include the phrase **“Amazon End-to-End VA”** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description.



## Important



Applicants must be honest about their level of experience. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid skills assessment involving listing analysis, inventory review, Seller Central troubleshooting, and preparation of a sample weekly report.

What is this role?

As a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer at Comet CX, you will work closely with our Architects and CX Consultants across our Australian and Manila teams to help design, build, and maintain Marketing Cloud solutions for our clients. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to grow their SFMC skills in a supportive, collaborative environment while contributing to real client outcomes. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



1. Solution Development & Customisation — Contribute to the development of tailored solutions across the Salesforce Marketing Stack, including personalised customer experiences using Salesforce Personalisation.

2. Campaign Design & Management — Assist in designing, implementing, and managing multi-channel marketing campaigns spanning
, SMS, and push notifications, leveraging Journey Builder to build automated customer journeys.

3. Data Configuration & Management — Support data configuration, segmentation, and integrity within Marketing Cloud, including managing data flows and synchronisation between Salesforce Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud.

4. System Integration — Assist in integrating Marketing Cloud with CRM, ERP, and third-party platforms, ensuring seamless data connectivity and enriched customer insights via Salesforce Data Cloud.

- Automation & Scripting — Build and maintain automation workflows using Journey Builder and Automation Studio, and support the implementation of real-time engagement solutions using Marketing Cloud Engagement.
